question: Explain the features of monopolistic competition.
sources: Monopolistic competition (standard microeconomic theory of market structures)

points.label: Large number of sellers
points.description: There are many sellers, each with a small share of the market, acting fairly independently.

points.label: Product differentiation
points.description: Products are close but not perfect substitutes, differing in brand, design, quality, packaging or service; this gives each firm some control over its price.

points.label: Downward sloping demand curve
points.description: Each firm faces a downward sloping, fairly elastic demand curve, so it must lower price to sell more.
points.basis: Monopolistic competition: demand curve of the firm

points.label: Selling costs
points.description: Firms spend on advertising and sales promotion to attract buyers and shift their demand curves.

points.label: Free entry and exit
points.description: Firms can enter and leave freely, so in the long run firms earn only normal profits.
points.basis: Monopolistic competition: entry, exit and long-run equilibrium
